snippet.title: My Dear Emma: Prologue Demo (First Reveal)
snippet.description:
🌿 This story begins with a letter…

My Dear Emma is a heartfelt narrative adventure that intertwines the emotional journey of Emma, a young biologist and photographer with the enduring legacy of her late grandfather. Inspired by real-life stories, this deeply personal tale invites players to uncover memories, family secrets, and reflections on love, loss, and the ties that shape us. 

💚 Play the free Demo Now! 
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4345540/My_Dear_Emma_Prologue/

💌 Add My Dear Emma to your wishlist on Steam and be part of our indie journey: 
👉 https://www.soulven.com/join/

Join our community for updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and to share your thoughts:

Thank you for supporting indie games! Every wishlist truly makes a difference!
